settings.label: OpenCode binary
settings.description: Absolute path of the opencode program to run. Leave blank to find it automatically (PATH, your login shell's PATH, common install folders).

settings.label: Model
settings.description: The model a new OpenCode chat starts on, as provider/model. Blank: the first enabled model of the list.

settings.label: Effort
settings.description: Reasoning effort of a new OpenCode chat when the model has levels. Default leaves it to OpenCode.

settings.label: Models switched off
settings.description: Models of the OpenCode list that the model picker leaves out, as provider/model. Switched in Settings > Agent > OpenCode.

settings.label: MCP servers switched on
settings.description: MCP servers OpenCode offers in Writer's chats, by name (every character outside letters, digits, _ and - is _). Off unless listed; Writer's own server is always on. Switched in Settings > Agent > OpenCode.

settings.label: Providers switched off
settings.description: OpenCode providers (by id) that Writer's chats never use: their models are not offered and a chat on one is refused. On unless listed. Switched in Settings > Agent > OpenCode.

settings.label: Cheap tier model
settings.description: Model for the cheap tier: the read-only writer-explorer sub-agent and automatic chat titles, as provider/model. Blank: the chat's own model.

settings.label: Standard tier model
settings.description: Model for the standard tier: the writer-worker sub-agent that makes delegated edits, as provider/model. Blank: the chat's own model.

settings.label: Strong tier model
settings.description: Model for the strong tier, for sub-agents that need the most capable model (none uses it yet), as provider/model. Blank: the chat's own model.
